title: Klang's Vanilla+
description:
A modpack made for a specific server containing mostly Vanilla+ mods. May use freely for a private world (Some mods won't work) or for a server.
-Klang
body:
Uses Fabric versions of mods for Java 1.21.1 to create a Vanilla+ Minecraft Experience. For better exploration and adventuring, I have added vanilla+ structure mods that recreate vanilla structures such as: Jungle Temples, Villages, Strongholds, and many more. I have also added QOL (quality of life) mods, Such as: [Easy Magic], [Xaero's Minimap], [Xaero's World Map], and a few more. I have also added some POV mods such as: [Better Third Person] and [First Person Model]. I've also added a few sound/realism mods such as: [Falling Leaves], [AmbientSounds], [Sound Physics Remastered], and a few more.(https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered/version/fabric-1.21.1-1.4.8)(https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds/version/6.1.4)(https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves/version/1.16.4+1.21)(https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model/version/2.4.8)(https://modrinth.com/mod/better-third-person/version/1.9.0)(https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map/version/1.39.2_Fabric_1.21)(https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap/version/25.0.0_Fabric_1.21)
(https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-magic/version/v21.1.0-1.21.1-Fabric)
People can download this to have a (mostly) lightweight Vanilla+ modpack to play on a server, singleplayer, or even with [Essential] (To play in free multiplayer world)(https://modrinth.com/mod/essential).
Some mods in singleplayer may not work well or at all, and some may produce lag. If you are playing singleplayer switch off Chat mods.
